title: Liouville-type theorems for coupled-drift Monge-Ampère equations
summary:
In this paper, we study entire solutions and periodic correctors for the coupled-drift Monge-Ampère equation \[ \det D^2u = \exp\{-a\cdot Du+b\cdot x+V(x)-c_0\}, \quad D^2u>0. \] For $V\equiv0$, we obtain a sharp classification of the whole-space solvability regimes: all entire smooth strictly convex solutions are quadratic when $a=b=0$; no such solution exists when $a
eq0$ and $a\cdot b\le0$; and non-quadratic entire solutions exist when $a=0$ and $b
eq0$, or when $a\cdot b>0$. For the null case $a
eq0$, $a\cdot b=0$, we give a scalar maximum-principle argument in every dimension…
